root_cause.text: The function `dtv5100_i2c_msg()` uses a user-controlled `rlen` value in `memcpy(st->data, rbuf, rlen)` without validating that `rlen` does not exceed the size of the `st->data` buffer, leading to an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message both state "rlen value is a user-controlled value, but dtv5100_i2c_msg() does not check the size of the rlen value. Therefore, if it is set to a value larger than sizeof(st->data), an out-of-bounds vuln occurs for st->data." The patch adds `if (rlen > sizeof(st->data))` to prevent the overflow.
